title: STATIC FIELD — Tabletop & Paper Arcade Recovery Dossier
scope: Bounded audit of connected GitHub PR metadata, Google Drive files, prior-chat recollections, public Front Room orientation. Not exhaustive, published, merged, licensed or playtested by implication.

entries.name: The Neighbor Experiment
entries.paper: Six handwritten cards + crossing slip
entries.loop: Two NEED / OFFER / BOUNDARY sets -> listen -> propose a limited crossing -> MEANING / CONSENT / BOUNDARIES / REALITY gates -> ADMIT, HOLD or REFUSE.
entries.value: A tiny Golden Rule game where a respectful no is a legitimate ending.
entries.next: Print, cut, run a two-person dry run; ask participants if saying no felt easy.
entries.boundary: v1.0 paper rules exist; no documented external playtest; the index mentions a prior printable PDF not confirmed in Drive.

entries.name: Who Murdered Tomorrow? / Case 001
entries.paper: Host case file, six suspect slips, ten clue cards, three envelopes, verdict sheet
entries.loop: Investigate fictional missing place setting -> examine A/B/C clue envelopes -> interrogate six suspects -> render evidence-grounded verdict -> optional card coda.
entries.value: Finished case-dinner format, with original host and player packets.
entries.next: Run one home-host session; keep solution private; verify live route before public promotion.
entries.boundary: Owner-approved live deployment was documented Oct 23; direct web availability could not be confirmed during this audit; no community host adoption proven.

entries.name: The Right Hands / Common Table 001
entries.paper: Nine-page 24-card POSTYMON x REALITY.2 PDF + local HTML matching workbench
entries.loop: NOTICE a real capacity -> pair with a hypothetical possible action -> OFFER, PASS, RETURN -> record only what participants actually confirmed.
entries.value: Physical card grammar anchored in Waseca field work: 12 POSTYMON existence cards + 12 REALITY.2 possibility cards.
entries.next: Add a one-page exact-turn rulesheet and conduct a strictly fictional matching game first.
entries.boundary: Field discussion prototype, not approved program or real help exchange. Adapted webZ card sidecar PR was review-only and not verified live.

entries.name: Little Yes Express 007
entries.paper: Printable cards/tickets in experimental branch; rail/map/resource tokens to trim
entries.loop: Six towns -> nine candidate rails -> shared food/wood/ore -> limited route builds and crafts -> complete rail, food-arrival and firewood-arrival missions.
entries.value: Clearest medium-size cooperative board-game product already implemented; deterministic dispatcher explains options.
entries.next: Produce one bounded 2-page rules sheet, map board and a real four-player blind paper test.
entries.boundary: Runnable/tested but source lives in open unmerged experimental PRs; all resources and consent are fictional.

entries.name: Who Built Your Kingdom? / Earth Remembers 008
entries.paper: Worker-voice cards and listening-circle prompts needed for paper edition
entries.loop: Build on 007 railway -> read the labor/ledger/worker-voice consequences -> make listening and permission decisions -> return a question without claiming consent.
entries.value: A second authored game lens over the same railway runtime, not merely a different theme or real worker statement.
entries.next: Extract complete 008 victory and turn rules into a stand-alone paper annex.
entries.boundary: Playable in 008 experimental offline shelf; fictional worker representations are not real assent.

entries.name: Wormhole Wars 001-003
entries.paper: 4-piece core deck; three-lane table; charge and crossing markers
entries.loop: Place SIGNAL and RECEIVER ports -> offer SECOND CHAIR -> open MISSING CORNER -> select adapter -> verify bridge -> destination ADMIT/HOLD/REFUSE -> inspect/attune/cross.
entries.value: Already has real tabletop grammar and illustrated pieces plus a bounded receiving-game second act.
entries.next: Distill 15-minute zero-server two-chair print-and-play edition.
entries.boundary: Experiment runs in stacked unmerged branches, not authenticated multiplayer or a real cross-world effect.

entries.name: PostEmahh'n Living Deck 001 / Fellowship Table
entries.paper: Four cards + six verb stickers: ECHO, POUR, OPEN, GROW, CALL, WAIT
entries.loop: Choose illustrated source cards -> attach verb sticker -> check legal composition -> play a local synthesized audio loop or hold a bounded quest/room proposal.
entries.value: Printed objects can compose media and an optional project proposal, instead of merely representing points.
entries.next: Publish a single-sheet cut deck and a no-code table adjudication key.
entries.boundary: Cards are local fixture illustrations, not authentic issued/source-verified PostEmahh'n objects; PR draft/unmerged.

entries.name: First Bell / WORLDSEED Porch
entries.paper: Bell, knock, open-corner and charge tokens; event sheet
entries.players: Solo/pair adapted; not tested on paper
entries.loop: Attend the Porch -> ring or miss an event -> preserve unanswered Bell and Knock -> follow residue and constraints; what was missed stays missed.
entries.value: Source of narrative consequence, opportunity cost and persistent unresolved state for a campaign.
entries.next: Convert one deterministic episode to 12 illustrated event cards, with missed-clue rule.
entries.boundary: 22 automated tests and build reported, but branch open; not a released tabletop title.

entries.name: Expansion Forge 009
entries.paper: Recipe cards, local event log, candidate rule slips
entries.loop: Import 007/008 synthetic event history -> derive three source-grounded rule proposals -> receiver chooses ADMIT/HOLD/REFUSE -> play new 007 variant -> produce return seed.
entries.value: A real working prototype of a game that makes another game using six bounded recipes.
entries.next: Make an analogue six-recipe judge and human-verifiable event-to-rule worksheet.
entries.boundary: 36/36 local tests reported; game is fictional and review-only, not a live community rules marketplace.

entries.name: Living World Atlas 010
entries.paper: World passports + crossing envelopes + fork map
entries.players: Multiple simulated tables; human sessions untested
entries.loop: Source world packages a 009 variant -> independent recipient chooses -> run a forked native game -> send optional return envelope -> combine compatible worlds into local constellations.
entries.value: Campaign continuity between separate tables without forcing a shared sovereign authority.
entries.next: Design paper passports with two independent signature/consent spaces.
entries.boundary: Browser simulates independent tables on one screen; files travel manually; hashes verify bytes, not identity.

entries.name: World Breeder 011
entries.paper: Two parent-world cards, two-YES gate, child rule card
entries.players: Two parent tables simulated; no physical playtest
entries.loop: Combine source-grounded connection/dignity or connection/witness mechanics -> both parent worlds freely opt in -> child requires AUDIT and LISTEN before BUILD, then RELAY.
entries.value: Makes a genuinely novel third rule, not just the sum of two win conditions.
entries.next: Test the two-parent negotiation as a 20-minute co-op pen-and-paper game.
entries.boundary: Open stacked PR with reported local 59-test pass; not authenticated multi-table collaboration.

entries.name: World Garden 012
entries.paper: Seed, observe, tend, graft, harvest and acknowledgement slips
entries.loop: Plant rules from source worlds -> OBSERVE/TEND -> separately accept -> compose child through 011 -> acknowledge disputed 42 vs 39 WOOD ledger -> SHARE only by choice.
entries.value: Growth metaphor becomes concrete finite actions with provenance-preserving mechanics.
entries.next: Turn seed care and incompatibility into explicit tactile card costs.
entries.boundary: 72/72 tests reported; disputed wood has no spendable real-world stock; open draft.

entries.name: Seed Exchange 013 / Jubilee Caravan
entries.paper: Four table mats, witnessed seed packets, ordered co-op mission deck
entries.players: Four simulated tables; no real cross-table playtest
entries.loop: Each table produces a witnessed seed -> receive with independent HOLD/REFUSE/ADMIT -> require two independent admitted sources -> parent YES x2 + host ADMIT -> perform ordered co-op mission.
entries.value: Most developed paper-arcade federation: different tables make independently governed games together.
entries.next: Pilot with four actual paper tables and manual packet exchange; stop before any real-world coordination claims.
entries.boundary: Simulated fictional tables in open draft; no external network, verified people or real-world deeds.

entries.name: Constitute 001/002 - Echo / Machine / Correspondence
entries.paper: Encounter door, route choice, inheritance card, turn-delay markers
entries.loop: Initial room choice compiles Echo rhythm, Machine three-slot construction or Correspondence delayed-mail game -> finish -> freeze lineage card -> spend earned inherited mechanic in second generation.
entries.value: Direct analogue foundation for a build-your-own-game anthology.
entries.next: Publish one page each for the three successor grammars.
entries.boundary: Experimental DerekDerrikDark branch; second generation only; not proof of cross-project permissions.

entries.name: Full Measure Garden + Grace / An Ordinary Tuesday
entries.paper: Character/quest sheets; scarce attention, cash, food and travel tokens; rest, relation and wild cards
entries.loop: Choose a finite practical action -> receive consequences -> distinguish offer/report/confirmation; Grace adds recharging, interruptions, one-thing-at-a-time focus and opportunity-cost receipts.
entries.value: A resource-scarcity co-op RPG where rest is an allowed move and completed work needs independent confirmation.
entries.next: Extract a first single-day board + eight finite resource pieces.
entries.boundary: Core slice merged; Grace campaign open branch; all field consequences are prototypes unless externally confirmed.

entries.name: Tomorrow 002 / The Question Key Town
entries.paper: Three clue cards, key construction mat, resource crafting counters
entries.loop: After case 001, combine A02 + B02 + C01 into Question Key -> investigate seven town places -> use source-pinned Alchematrix to mine/craft/observe -> open a further observatory.
entries.value: A legitimate second chapter with a puzzler/crafting conversion pathway.
entries.next: Create 12-card town expansion and verify public routes before printing promotional QR.
entries.boundary: Owner-approved production claimed Oct 23; current public site not independently reachable via web tool in this session.

entries.name: Case 002 / The Vanishing Carton (Milk Bridge)
entries.paper: Milk sourcing clue/decision cards; public-safe question slip
entries.loop: Play fictional lost-milk mystery -> distinguish constraints and unsupported conclusions -> optionally carry one editable public-safe sourcing question to a private seven-day table.
entries.value: A replicable mystery franchise linked to the case dinner format.
entries.next: Finish the stand-alone print packet and keep guest invitation keys off public handouts.
entries.boundary: PR open (not merged); referenced seven-day table has private invitation capabilities and no claimed participants.

entries.name: The Missing Ingredient / Field 001
entries.paper: Ingredient/quantity tokens, meal tickets, role/state slips, circular page
entries.loop: Choose fictional recipe -> identify have/missing/unknown -> negotiate possible offers -> PROPOSE/ACCEPT/REPORT/CONFIRM or DECLINE -> publish only a fictional local circular.
entries.value: A kitchen-table game of bounded resource allocation and honest return.
entries.next: Print three recipes and 12 ingredient tokens; independently test without web app.
entries.boundary: Experimental standalone demo, no real food inventory, delivery or automatic journalism.

entries.name: Living Watershed Quest
entries.paper: Six site tiles; observer/researcher/steward role cards; action and rest slips
entries.loop: Walk six fictional Willow Run places -> choose role-limited conservation action -> update fictional story -> HOLD, REST or export a paper quest card.
entries.value: Low-friction conservation board game; no GPS, accounts or actual field data necessary.
entries.next: Make a 6-site foldout board with independently readable fictional evidence cards.
entries.boundary: Live Oct 24 was recorded in PR; not a Blue Earth/EcoMapper affiliation or verified field action.

entries.name: UNFUTURES Reciprocity Reactor / Quest Board
entries.paper: Five-town map; offers/needs/transport capacity slips; consent and confirmation ledger
entries.loop: Find capacity-conserving 2/3-town resource cycles -> seek provider/recipient/driver acceptance separately -> mark reported legs -> independently confirm or leave incomplete.
entries.value: Interesting alternative to bilateral trading board games: a closed loop can fulfill multiple towns.
entries.next: Create 5-town resource ledger and a physical anti-double-spend rule.
entries.boundary: Synthetic 5/5 model only; 0 actual deliveries and no live Reality.2 integration.

entries.name: The Living Lego Floor
entries.paper: Five component cards and four typed sockets; proof/hold cards
entries.loop: Drag components into typed sockets -> incompatible choices HOLD -> inspect original provenance -> approve an exact qualified relation -> issue non-authorizing inspection packet.
entries.value: A game about making tools from tools: physical combinatorics and compatibility rather than chance.
entries.next: Manufacture cardboard sockets; test if players can explain why a composition fails.
entries.boundary: Open Workbench PR; artifact compatibility is not permission to run other systems.

entries.name: Question Arcade 001 / Idle Scout
entries.paper: Synthetic observation cards, hypotheses, learning chips, routing/hold desk
entries.loop: OBSERVE -> GUESS -> TEACH -> compare examples -> Idle Scout predicts fictional cases -> manual HOLD of community routing candidates.
entries.value: Turns a lightweight machine-learning training loop into an explainable educational tabletop exercise.
entries.next: Print 18 training cards and a transparent nearest-neighbor ruler/score sheet.
entries.boundary: Local unit tests passed; browser QA incomplete; no real community action or live JAR;VIS handoff.

entries.name: MEMENTO Inside Garden / Understory
entries.paper: Time/Curiosity lens tiles, body chapter log, encounter tokens
entries.loop: Explore one fictional world through distinct attention lenses -> encounter physical constraints -> carry chapter history -> receiver interprets an artifact without inheriting source authority.
entries.value: Unusual dreamlike exploratory RPG where perception changes the view, not the facts.
entries.next: Test paper lens overlays and a 20-turn foldout chapter journal.
entries.boundary: Private/experimental remembered-world work, source-separated from canonical memory; an offline prototype, not merged canon.

entries.name: DVOTE LifeGame / Paula 42
entries.paper: Daily encounter cards, three doors, reflection journal, weekly return strip
entries.loop: OPEN -> READ -> CHOOSE -> GO LIVE -> WITNESS -> COMPOSE -> CLOSE; 42-day variant offers 126 optional real-world doors.
entries.value: Practice-based personal game without faith scores or manipulated streak mechanics.
entries.next: Separate a non-prescriptive 7-card tabletop sampler from the devotional publication.
entries.boundary: The core digital game merged; Paula 42 exists in open PR. No claimed spiritual metric or human outcome.

entries.name: Groovetown / The Town That Plays Itself
entries.paper: Town graphs, music-state and need-confirmation cards, routes
entries.loop: A fictional need is surfaced; a separate confirmation changes the town sound; route inventories and hypothetical repairs are tested before any proposed multi-town action.
entries.value: Musical tabletop simulation where actual completion makes the soundtrack change.
entries.next: Design a scoreless music-state tracker with fixed sound cues and optional instrument.
entries.boundary: Six numbered experiments linked from later work; catalog lineage is not proof every phase is a complete independent game.

entries.name: TABLE & ROAD (22-card wandering deck)
entries.paper: 22 individually written cards in TABLE/HOUSE/ROAD/HAND/FIELD/SONG households
entries.loop: LOOK at image -> TRY optional low-cost practice -> CARRY or keep/recycle -> no required tracking or return.
entries.value: Strong visual print line and potential seed for future games, but not currently a scored or bounded standalone game.
entries.next: Print 12-card sampler and invite users to propose game rules without making reflection transactional.
entries.boundary: Draft take-home art deck; distinct from transactional Right Hands. No church/festival endorsement.

entries.name: THE NEXT TABLE / One Table, Seven Days
entries.paper: Four OFFER/NEED/BUILD/QUESTION prompt cards; optional host inheritance kit
entries.loop: Close the fictional game -> voluntarily open a real table conversation -> separately accept one small task -> optionally hand kit to next host.
entries.value: Distribution and repeat-hosting protocol capable of carrying many games.
entries.next: Bind as an optional closing insert, not an automatic part of any game.
entries.boundary: Protocol is not itself proof of host adoption; private seat links never printed as public game identifiers.

entries.name: Jubilee Field 001 / Penny Box
entries.paper: NEED/OFFER cards, five-state receipt and 10-minute facilitator guide
entries.loop: SEE need -> OFFER bounded capacity -> separately ACCEPT -> REPORT fictional act -> independent CONFIRM, REFUSE or withdraw.
entries.value: A useful role-separation teaching game with tangible paper pieces.
entries.next: Frame a standalone 10-minute roleplay game with failure cases and no actual cash.
entries.boundary: Pilot worksheet, not a live public intake or proof of delivery.

entries.name: Living Cards 001 / Response Grammar
entries.paper: HAVE/NEED/CAN_DO cards plus voluntary reply/return slips
entries.loop: Make one bounded card -> manually offer to another person -> receive optional reply -> REPORT what occurred -> independent confirm/dispute or nothing.
entries.value: The practical release valve between fictional paper games and real-world help.
entries.next: Create identical printable source and response slips; audit self-authenticating claims.
entries.boundary: Open PRs only. Card hashes are not identity, consent, ownership, performance or settlement.

entries.name: PENNY Haunted Jubilee Arcade / Lost Minute Post Office
entries.paper: Crank postcard; KEEP/COMPOST/HAUNT; source-bound minute return postcard
entries.loop: One mechanical detent produces at most one offer -> choose an image treatment and explicit retention -> hand off postcard -> recipient HOLD; separate minute kindness edition is a source-reviewed print/film experiment.
entries.value: Arcade cabinets as tiny physical publishing and correspondence games.
entries.next: Design one postcard-only table variant before hardware production.
entries.boundary: No physical crank, real camera, printer operation, or delivered kindness proved; both PRs open drafts.

entries.name: SPARKFORK
entries.paper: Two offering cards, interest-circle card, remix challenge
entries.loop: Feed two fictional things to a campfire -> reveal a whimsical seven-day invitation -> optionally remix the rule.
entries.value: Fastest party opener, but its Aippy-hosted launch was not performed.
entries.next: Build and test one truly stand-alone paper edition.
entries.boundary: PR contains a first-build prompt and manual launch kit, not a published Aippy game.

entries.name: Dug-ins and Drag-ins
entries.paper: Family/adventure board, quest tracks, character boards, magnetic markers
entries.loop: Choose daily/weekly/life quests -> roleplay family decisions -> assign sustainable rewards/limits -> hold a weekly council -> change the path.
entries.value: Early physical whiteboard tabletop design, rediscovered in prior conversation history.
entries.next: Recover original conversation/artifacts and separate consensual habit coaching from coercive rewards.
entries.boundary: Only prior-chat recovery; no independently located code, playtest or issued print pack.

entries.name: Wrong World / Peel & Reconstitute
entries.paper: Wrong-world cards, primitive deck, decoder rings, evolving character sheets
entries.loop: Start in an almost-right world -> PEEL assumptions -> identify primitives -> RECONSTITUTE with table-authored grammar -> play consequences -> preserve inherited receipts.
entries.value: Potential flagship self-authoring tabletop: progression unlocks new rules and nested decks.
entries.next: Publish one wrong-world puzzle with six primitive cards and an unambiguous end condition.
entries.boundary: Prior-chat design only; no independently verified game build found in this pass.

entries.name: Smoke Signals / Poke Back
entries.paper: POKE / ACK / OFFER / BOUNDARY cards and timeout tokens
entries.loop: Send a minimal signal -> allow silence or ACK -> only then offer more detail -> each crossing explicitly optional.
entries.value: A conversational etiquette mini-game based on the smallest reversible social gesture.
entries.next: Turn into a 5-minute paired game without collecting contacts or claiming delivery.
entries.boundary: Browser tabs / smoke signal experiment mentioned in conversation; no completed standalone tabletop release verified.

entries.name: Soup as Infrastructure / The Crossing
entries.paper: Shared pot, missing ingredients, independent table passports
entries.loop: One game feeds an imaginary neighborhood under bounded offers; the other negotiates what two independent worlds will exchange or refuse.
entries.value: Both already appear as concepts in the dated tabletop library ledger; easy to prototype from existing rules.
entries.next: Treat as two separate working titles before drafting mechanics.
entries.boundary: Ideas recorded in ledger; no complete rules or field test found.
